purpose: Teach: 声援/町民/趙/マメ/穂/山々/見所/７つ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、応援団で声援すごかったな
lines.en: Riku, you were incredible with the cheer squad—your voice carried.
lines.style: Bright, playful admiration. Leans forward slightly. The tone of someone who noticed and wants him to know she noticed. Quick, warm rhythm on the whole thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、町民マラソン出てたな、桜
lines.en: You ran in the town marathon, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Light deflection—turning the attention back on her without making it awkward. Small smile underneath. Gentle and observant, the way he notices things she does.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、留学生の趙くんと仲良くなったろ
lines.en: So you got close with Zhao, the exchange student. That happened fast.
lines.style: Casual curiosity with a thread of teasing underneath. Head tilt. Not accusatory—just noticing, the way friends do. Warm territory.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、マメに勉強記録付けてたな、桜
lines.en: You kept such detailed study notes—really diligent about that, weren't you?
lines.style: Genuine observation without flattery. Steady, matter-of-fact. There's something tender in the noticing itself. Not trying to impress, just acknowledging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で稲穂が描かれた紙幣について調べてたな
lines.en: You were researching those banknotes with the rice stalks printed on them in social studies.
lines.style: Simple statement of fact. No inflection that asks for agreement. Curious in the way of someone cataloging something that mattered. Patient.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で山々の写真撮ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were taking all those mountain photos on the school trip.
lines.style: Soft, straightforward recall. Like he's turning something over in his mind. No question mark underneath—just stating what he saw, what he remembers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭の展示で「我が校の見所」って書いてたな
lines.en: You wrote that whole display about 'our school's highlights' for the culture festival.
lines.style: Steady observation. Small note of appreciation for the effort. Not forcing a reaction, just naming the thing he saw her do. Genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お弁当のおかず７つも作ってもらってたろ、桜
lines.en: Your mom packed you seven different side dishes for lunch—that's a lot, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry warmth. Slight smile in the voice. The teasing of someone who knows what that kind of care looks like, and finds it both touching and faintly funny. Soft.
